Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- PATCH service references to explicit revision operations and retention; retain the workspace/controller organization and link to [G].
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
  |   |   `-- Add document.diagramContexts keyed by diagramId, with compact backing references or compatible inline snapshots; attach beneath the semantic document, separate from Diagram.sourceContext.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- PATCH DiagramService create/revise calls to stored revision commands; distinguish issuing and retaining content from committing canvas bindings. Preserve the separate-checkpoint exec contract.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- PATCH append's content-writer responsibility: history retains already issued immutable revisions and records bindings/checkpoints. Preserve navigation, forks and retained history.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |       `-- Replace the obsolete single-service boundary with immutable revision operations, explicit runtime retention, generateDiagram orchestration and separate canvas publication; preserve validation and proven node correspondence. Connect from the controller's content-edit component.
  |
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   |-- Reorganize the flow around uploaded, explicitly saved, panel-supplied and diagram-associated context; the former upload-to-generation path no longer explains the responsibilities.
  |   |   |-- Show AgentContextService resolving uploads or AgentContextLibrary records, and DiagramEditService loading a matching diagram association only when no explicit context or supplied submission exists.
  |   |   |-- Show DiagramEditService owning runs and calling generateDiagram or submitStoredDiagramEdit; issuance and retention precede guarded canvas application or variant installation.
  |   |   |-- Preserve version checks, cancellation boundaries and exact-revision acknowledgement retries; distinguish panel identity, runtime session identity and context returned after acknowledgement.
  |   |   `-- Introduce explicit AgentContextLibrary, AgentContextSources and DiagramAgentContextStore component nodes before linking their details below.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
  |   |   |-- PATCH the existing request categories with saved/uploaded agentContextId, inline agentContext, llmSessionId, pinned prompt references and template selection.
  |   |   `-- Add required edit-mode and replace-mode, whole/single-subtree/multiple-subtree targets, variant refinement and optional presentation promotion; these remain request-domain concerns.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
  |   |   |-- PATCH the retained-run model with operation, context provenance, runtime session ID, next conversation context, variants and created outputs.
  |   |   `-- Preserve request-key deduplication and retry states; expose updated conversation context only after successful canvas acknowledgement.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
  |   |   |-- PATCH version-1-only serialization and direct conversion: source-bearing snapshots require version 2 and must resolve sources before toPiMessages().
  |   |   `-- Preserve branch slicing, tool-group validation, defensive copying and the absence of direct file/network ownership.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
  |   |   |-- Add sourceRange message constituents, optional sourceFiles transport attachments, fromMessages(), withMessages(), withoutSourceFiles() and resolveSources().
  |   |   `-- Keep descriptor hashes separate from attachments and resolved text; attach source-resolution detail to resolveSources(). The value-object organization still fits.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
  |   |   |-- PATCH SessionManager.inMemory to persisted SessionManager.create sessions and show explicit AI enablement checks.
  |   |   `-- Preserve copied-history isolation and runtime-owned configuration; distinguish the panel conversation identity from each actual agent session ID.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
  |   |   |-- Add retained candidate revisions and DiagramRevisionReview references alongside installed bindings; optional DiagramAlternative promotion remains a separate presentation choice.
  |   |   `-- The output-domain organization still fits; connect review and presentation components to their existing detail in Central and side diagrams - Attempt 2 rather than duplicating it.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Saved AgentContext library lifecycle
  |   |   |-- Explain explicit creation, UUID retry identity, immutable exclusive publication, summary browsing and reading; uploads remain scoped and backend-lifetime, while saved IDs survive restarts within the application store.
  |   |   |-- Show AgentContextLibrary owning repository/source ports, FileAgentContextRepository storing records and AgentContextService.resolve selecting the appropriate lookup path.
  |   |   `-- Attach from the overview's AgentContextLibrary node. This develops the canvas's existing context lifecycle subject rather than introducing a separate canvas.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Pinned source evidence and lazy resolution
  |   |   |-- Explain sourceFile capture into sourceRange descriptors: explicit Git revisions resolve to commits; matching committed worktree content can reuse Git; other captures use shared immutable blobs.
  |   |   |-- Show persist validating references and removing attachments, read resolving selected text separately, and portable exporting only selected evidence as attached snapshots.
  |   |   |-- Distinguish the unchanged saved descriptor/hash from a separately resolved snapshot or transformed portable context; include unavailable-source and size-validation boundaries.
  |   |   `-- Attach from AgentContextSources in the overview and resolveSources() in [D3]. This supplies source-resolution detail without duplicating the saved-record lifecycle.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Diagram-associated AgentContext lifecycle
  |       |-- Explain compileDiagramAgentContext capturing source evidence, document.diagramContexts holding the association and DiagramAgentContextStore externalizing its immutable snapshot.
  |       |-- Show compiledFromRevisionId, sourceFingerprint, contentHash and backingRecordId; validate diagram identity and reuse only matching source fingerprints. Each edit still supplies its current diagram separately.
  |       `-- Attach from the overview's DiagramAgentContextStore and DiagramEditService context-selection nodes, with a cross-link from MappingPage's document.diagramContexts.
  |
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- PATCH the fixed tool-count claim and edit-diagram description to reflect explicit edit/replacement modes and saved or uploaded context IDs; preserve unrelated interfaces.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Add create-agent-context, list-agent-contexts and read-agent-context under a saved-context tool group, distinct from WebSocket agent-context.upload; connect to AgentContextLibrary in the backend diagram.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- PATCH prompt-driven editing to separate candidate generation, immutable issuance, retention and canvas installation; retain the existing request/execution/persistence grouping.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |       |-- Expand Agent context with AgentContextService -> AgentContextLibrary -> repository/source ports, and show DiagramEditService's DiagramAgentContextStore dependency.
  |       `-- These fit existing responsibility groups; link the explicit components to their detailed lifecycle diagrams on the AgentContext canvas.
  |
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |       |-- Add FileAgentContextRepository for immutable named records, FileDiagramAgentContextStore for external diagram-context records and shared FileAgentContextSources for source blobs or Git references.
  |       |-- Keep these beside the existing persistence components, not inside DiagramRevisionStore or catalog publication; snapshots/checkpoints retain compact references.
  |       `-- PATCH by extension because the storage-owner organization remains accurate. Link these explicit components to the AgentContext lifecycle details; preserve autosave versus explicit catalog publication.
  |
  `-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          |-- Add MappingWorkspaceService's injected DiagramAgentContextStore and the distinction between document associations and externally retained context/source payloads.
          `-- Attach beneath the server-side workspace service; the incremental record flow remains the organizing structure. Link to PersistentLayer's context stores without duplicating their internals.
